single_independent_change: bounded observation records only; original behavior, provider targets and initialization order preserved
frozen: init, model environment, kernel and all non-observer payloads
existing five NOP sites and all existing Backup return/output behavior
receive timeouts, original rc/errno, message ownership and queue lifetime
fixed run wall budget and capture checkpoints

provider_binding: actual relocation slot VMA, mapped module base, before/after pointer, dladdr provider owner
code patch old bytes, requested bytes, readback bytes and target mapping permissions
threads: creator TID, pthread entry pointer and owner DSO, child TID, begin/end reason, monotonic sequence
receive: entry/exit TID, LR captured before nested calls, caller base+offset, uint32 qid, signed32 timeout, out-slot address, original provider pointer, exact rc and saved errno
no speculative output-message dereference on failure or before completion
backup: entry/exit TID, LR, id, function, verified argument shape, return value; output bytes only when valid bounded contract established
read back selected actual GOT slots +2ef22f8/+2ef2220/+2ef2868
display: run-bound raw captured addresses, width/height/pitch/format/full SHA, primitive counters and no host-rendered substitution

acceptance.pass: full CPIO scan, hashes, no unplanned behavioral changes, bounded log collector verified; actual linked-provider ABI matches baseline
actual slot and patch readback or explicit unsupported record; no reliance on fixed=799 aggregate
entry function and TID linkage, or marked unknown; vCPU id not used as guest TID
real LR/qid/timeout records classify receiver; no timeout or fake message changes
separate visible-menu result from diagnostic-run result; all-zero frames keep menu unproven

failure_policy: record unsupported/missing binding or incomplete observation and end under the baseline existing owner policy; never fabricate success or force the original error path to continue
